column1: # (wired into scripts/check-format.ps1, the local commit gate -- this repo has no CI).
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Every image in docs/readme/ is declared a quality/layout FLOOR by
# #780/#800. docs/readme/ED12-play-topdown.png was ALSO carrying a circular minimap, two
# quest-tracker panels and a player-position "Here" marker -- every one of which the binding
# acquired-map doctrine (#944 / ADR-944, #800 SS17, #1447, #1448) FORBIDS in the packaged
# player runtime. A blessed floor and a binding constraint drifted apart and nothing checked
# that they still agreed, so the next agent doing visual work would have faithfully rebuilt
# the omniscient navigation the operator prohibited. Prose warnings rot; this manifest does
# not. A reference artifact cannot enter or stay in this repo without a doctrine verdict.
#   NOT_RUNTIME    Does not depict the packaged player runtime: concept/lore art, marketing
#                  plate, menu screen, or EDITOR tooling UI. Editor authoring overviews --
#                  including an editor minimap / world-overview panel -- are creator tooling
#                  and are explicitly permitted; they must simply never ship as player HUD.
#   RUNTIME_CLEAN  Depicts packaged player runtime and is doctrine-clean: no built-in
#                  map/minimap, no GPS player dot, no quest pins/tracker, no route ribbon, no
#   FORBIDDEN_NAV  Depicts packaged player runtime containing at least one FORBIDDEN surface.
#                  The artifact is OBSOLETE on those elements. Every tracked markdown that
#                  presents it must carry the annotation token in column 3 within 8 lines of
#                  the reference, or the commit gate FAILS.
# annotation: for FORBIDDEN_NAV, the literal token every markdown presentation must carry.
#             For NOT_RUNTIME / RUNTIME_CLEAN it must be exactly '-'.
# HOW TO ADD AN IMAGE: look at it, decide the status, add the row. There is no default.
# HOW TO CLEAR A FORBIDDEN_NAV ROW: replace the artifact with a doctrine-clean capture
# (#1537 does this for ED12-play-topdown.png), then flip the row to RUNTIME_CLEAN and drop
# the annotation from the captions. Do NOT flip the row without replacing the pixels.
